payload.recallText:
"Whew!" whistled Joe Matson, his bronzed face showing his excitement.

"What is it?" asked his sister Sally.

"Well according to this letter, the Pittston team won't be needing my services soon. But that's alright, as I will be making a lot more money with this pitching arm!" He swung his arm behind him, as if to pitch a ball.

"Joe, look out!" Sally shouted.

Just then, there was a crashing noise as their mother walked in carrying a jug, which now crashed to the floor.

"Oh no, the carpet is ruined!" she said. "At least it wasn't a good jug. What's this commotion about?"

"Yours truly will be pitching for the Saint Louis Nationals! Well, it isn't settled yet, but we'll be negotiating."

"Drafted? That makes it sound like you're going to war."

"Well, lots of people don't like the system, although I personally don't have any problems with it."
